name: White-bellied Cinclodes
rangeDescription: Andes of central peru (junín, lima, and huancavelica)
description: Striking, critically endangered bird found only at extremely high elevations in the Andes of central Peru. One of the most beautiful members of the ovenbird family, with immaculate white underparts and wing patches contrasting with its deep chestnut upperparts and gray crown.

name: Gray-headed Goshawk
rangeDescription: New guinea, including aru islands (off southwestern new guinea), and d'entrecasteaux and louisiade archipelagos (off southeastern new guinea)
description: An Inconspicuous, mid-sized raptor of the lowland and foothill forest interior. Dark eye, dark gray back, pale gray head and whitish belly, although a rare, dark-bellied form also occurs.

name: Lesser Nothura
rangeDescription: Semiarid grassland and scrub of interior southeastern brazil and east-central paraguay
description: Sandy-colored tinamou that usually holds an upright posture. Has a brown crown and a heavily streaked back and throat.

name: Gold-naped Finch
rangeDescription: Montane forest of northern india to southwestern china, southeastern tibet, and northern myanmar
description: A small dark finch of high mountain forests. Male is glossy black with a bright yellow nape.

name: Eastern Spot-billed Duck
rangeDescription: Breeds northeastern asia; winters to southern china, taiwan, and philippines
description: Common large duck of lakes, ponds, wet fields, and estuaries. Dark brown overall, with a pale head marked by a whitish eyebrow and two black stripes on the face.

name: Upland Antshrike
rangeDescription: Lower andean slopes of far southeastern peru (puno) and northwestern bolivia
description: Small antshrike found in the Andes of Bolivia and adjacent areas of Peru near the border. Male is gray with white wingbars and pale eyes; female is brown with a gray face.

name: Tufted Coquette
rangeDescription: Eastern venezuela, trinidad, and the guianas to northern brazil
description: Tiny, ornately patterned hummingbird with a bold pale rump band. Exquisite adult male plumage features a bushy orange crest and long orange plumes tipped dark green, sweeping back from the cheeks over the shoulders, and set off by a white rump band and stout orange bill tipped black.

name: Orange-billed Babbler
rangeDescription: Humid forest of sri lanka
description: A large, uniform rufous-brown babbler with conspicuous orange bill and feet, and a beady yellow eye. Highly gregarious, usually encountered in noisy flocks within wet rainforest understory.

name: Guadalupe Murrelet
rangeDescription: San benito island and guadalupe island (off baja california)
description: Small black-and-white diving seabird, unlikely to be seen from land. Usually found as singles or pairs, well offshore, and not usually associating with other seabirds.

name: Slaty-backed Forest-Falcon
rangeDescription: Humid costa rica to bolivia and amazonian brazil
description: Forest-falcons are well-named raptors; they are found almost exclusively inside the forest. They are generally slender and long-tailed, with long legs.

name: Ecuadorian Thrush
rangeDescription: Coastal western ecuador (esmeraldas) to far northwestern peru (tumbes)
description: A common thrush of clearings and forest edge in most of western Ecuador; also reaches far northwestern Peru. Adult’s tan plumage, yellow bill, and orange eyering are distinct in its range.

name: Venezuelan Wood-Quail
rangeDescription: Western venezuela (southwestern táchira) and coastal cordillera eastward to miranda
description: A robust and beautiful forest-dwelling quail with a short crest and a stout bill. Mostly rufous-brown body, boldly scaled white below and streaked white above.
imageCreditName: Jhonathan Miranda - Wandering Venezuela Birding Expeditions

name: Spotted Sandpiper
rangeDescription: Breeds north america; winters to southern south america
description: Small shorebird. Constantly bobs its tail while working edges of streams, ponds, and lakes for invertebrates.

name: Bornean Frogmouth
rangeDescription: Montane forest of borneo
description: Small stout frogmouth with a face full of wispy whiskers. Males are dark brown overall; females are bright rufous.

name: Caroline Islands Ground Dove
rangeDescription: Montane forest of eastern caroline islands (chuuk and pohnpei)
description: Beautiful dark velvet dove with a pristine white face, throat, and breast. Endemic to Chuuk and Pohnpei, in the Caroline Islands group.

name: Nicobar Bulbul
rangeDescription: Forest of nicobar islands
description: A plain bulbul with brown upperparts and paler underparts. Note the pale, heavy bill and the short, pale eyebrow.

name: Parrot-billed Sparrow
rangeDescription: Far southeastern south sudan, southern ethiopia, eastern uganda, kenya, southern somalia, and northeastern tanzania
description: A drab sparrow of northeastern Africa. The head and underparts are gray, the wing and back are brown, and the rump is rufous.

name: Many-banded Aracari
rangeDescription: Northeastern colombia to southern venezuela, northeastern peru, and northwestern amazonian brazil
description: Fairly small toucan found in northwestern Amazonia. Often the most common speices of aracari within its range.

name: Australian Painted-Snipe
rangeDescription: Eastern and northern australia; vagrant to tasmania
description: Cryptic wader with long, slightly decurved greenish-yellow bill. Bright white underparts, dark brown head and neck, and streaked olive upperparts, with distinctive curved white line extending from breast through the back.

name: Gray-headed Imperial-Pigeon
rangeDescription: Montane forest of sulawesi
description: A large pigeon with a gray head and underside, except for a rufous undertail. Note the wide, pale gray bar on the tail.
